title: Baghare Baingan (Eggplant Curry)

steps.text: Roast the above till roasted and a warm aroma comes out.

steps.text: Now you put 2 tbsp fresh tamarind paste and chop up 2-3 dates and let it all simmer together for a few minutes.

steps.text: Slice you baby eggplants in 4 so that they are still attached at the top.

steps.text: Drop them in and let simmer till eggplants are soft now add lemon juice and serve.
